# moonpaws

> > moonpaws is a dog astrology app and product ecosystem that helps pet parents understand their dogs through zodiac cycles, lunar phases, and celestial transits.

moonpaws combines pet astrology guidance with oracle cards and celestial merchandise to help dog owners build better routines and deepen their connection with their pets. The platform covers zodiac seasons, lunar cycles, and astrological transits specifically tailored for dog behavior and wellness.

## Key Topics

- Pet Astrology
- Dog Behavior
- Lunar Cycles
- Zodiac Signs (Pisces, Aquarius, Aries, Leo, Virgo, Capricorn)
- New Moon & Full Moon
- Venus Transits
- Spring Equinox
- Oracle Cards
- Dog Training
- Pet Wellness
- Bonding Activities
- Horoscopes
- Astrology Basics
- Orbit's Oracle Deck
